Calculate pixel location of a capital E

calculate_E_offset.Rd

Draws a capital E via magick::image_annotate() with the specified font options, then calculates how far from the top left corner of the text box the actual E pixels are rendered.

This is used for positioning figure labels precisely based on the actual text spot (which E is used to stand in for) without considering hanging letters like g.

Usage

calculate_E_offset(
  font_size,
  font_family,
  font_style,
  font_weight,
  font_angle = 0
)

Arguments

font_size

numeric. The size argument passed to magick::image_annotate().

font_family

character. The font argument passed to magick::image_annotate().

font_style

character. The style argument passed to magick::image_annotate().

font_weight

numeric. The weight argument passed to magick::image_annotate().

font_angle

numeric. The degrees argument passed to magick::image_annotate(). Default: 0.

Value

list of numeric values. The distance in pixels from the text box to the left, top, bottom, and right of the E, as well as the height and width of the E.
